physics_and_rules.grouping: bundle derating factors as in IEC 60364-5-52 table B.52.17 (bunched in air): recalled, typical, unverified
physics_and_rules.insulation: PVC hook-up wire 80 degC (UL 1007), silicone 200 degC (UL 3135), PTFE/FEP 200 degC (UL 1332), glass-fibre sleeved heater leads 300 degC: typical, unverified
physics_and_rules.klipper: heater control: Klipper's own heaters.py / verify_heater.py / pid_calibrate.py classes are called when its source is installed (see heaters.<name>.control_code in the metrics); otherwise control laws ported from them. Also ported: thermistor.py, adc_temperature.py, tmc2208.py (github.com/Klipper3d/klipper, master, fetched 2026-11-14)
physics_and_rules.convection: natural convection: horizontal plate, hot side up Nu = 0.54 Ra^1/4 (Ra < 1e7) or 0.15 Ra^1/3; hot side down Nu = 0.27 Ra^1/4; vertical/compact body Churchill-Chu (Incropera, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, ch. 9). Air properties from power-law fits around 300-400 K.
physics_and_rules.enclosure_u: sealed enclosure wall transmittance 5.5 W/m^2K (painted sheet steel, common enclosure-sizing rule): typical, unverified
physics_and_rules.motor_h: stepper case to still air 12 W/m^2K over the motor's own surface, mounting plate ignored: ASSUMED (typical, unverified; it gives about the vendor's 80 K rise at rated current)
physics_and_rules.stepper_model: pull-out torque from the phasor model (V, R, L, back-EMF). Checked against StepperOnline's published 24 V pull-out curve for the 17HS13-0404S at 0.35 A rms: within 13 % from 120 to 900 rpm (tests/test_electrical.py). No extra derating is applied; mid-band resonance is not modelled.

Joint z has 5 mm of declared over-travel past the nozzle plane: the bed meeting the nozzle tip there was not counted as a collision (checked to 5 mm past). 2 part(s) on the nozzle's body (bed_probe, hotend) ride with the nozzle and were checked with the bed at nozzle contact plus their toolhead margin; every other pair was checked over the whole over-travel. The probe's face height and trigger margin are judged by the subsystems verifier.

11 elements are commodity parts with no single vendor part number fixed: ['hotend_heater', 'hotend_thermistor', 'hotend_fan', 'part_fan', 'case_fan', 'x_endstop', 'y_endstop', 'extruder', 'bed_tco', 'bed_heater', 'bed_ntc']. Their ratings are class values (see sources); fix a vendor part before purchase.
Cold-start inrush of psu is 60.0 A (data sheet, typical): the T5A time-lag fuse is assumed to ride through it; I2t was not checked.

Not modelled: EMC and noise coupling, firmware bugs, crimp and solder quality, connector wear, real PID autotune on the real heater, heater tolerance (+/-10 %), mains transients. See docs/ELECTRICAL.md.
